::: {.callout-warning}
This extension is superseded by [Git Link](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-gitlink).
:::

Every reference below is linked by the filter as this page is rendered.
The site sets the default repository in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
extensions:
  github:
    repository-name: jlord/sheetsee.js
    base-url: https://github.com
```

## Issues and pull requests

| Source | Renders as |
| --- | --- |
| `#26` | #26 |
| `GH-26` | GH-26 |
| `jlord/sheetsee.js#26` | jlord/sheetsee.js#26 |
| `github-linguist/linguist#4039` | github-linguist/linguist#4039 |

: Issue and pull request forms. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[50,50]"}

The first two need the configured `repository-name`; the last two name their own.

A full URL is shortened as well:

`https://github.com/jlord/sheetsee.js/issues/26` becomes https://github.com/jlord/sheetsee.js/issues/26 .

## Commits

| Source | Renders as |
| --- | --- |
| `jlord/sheetsee.js@a5c3785ed8d6a35868bc169f07e40e889087fd2e` | jlord/sheetsee.js@a5c3785ed8d6a35868bc169f07e40e889087fd2e |

: Commit forms. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[50,50]"}

A forty-character SHA on its own is shortened to seven characters and linked against the configured repository.

## Mentions

`@mcanouil` renders as @mcanouil and `@quarto-dev` as @quarto-dev , each linking to the profile.

## The punctuation limitation

A reference is only recognised when a space follows it.

| Source | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `see #26 here` | see #26 here |
| `see #26, here` | see #26, here |
| `ends with #26.` | ends with #26. |

: Punctuation immediately after a reference stops it being recognised. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[40,60]"}

Reword rather than fight it, or move to [Git Link](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-gitlink), which does not have this limitation.

## Source

The repository ships a short, standalone starting point you can copy: [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-github/blob/main/example.qmd).
